title: Draft an Internal Status Update
description: Write a concise executive update based on a scenario.
problemStatement:
You are the Incident Commander. It is 14:30 UTC. A ransomware incident is ongoing. The Accounting file server (FS01) is encrypted. 45 users are affected. The containment team has isolated the server VLAN. The recovery team estimates restoration from backup will take 4 hours. You need the CISO to approve an emergency change to block outbound SMB traffic at the firewall as a precaution.

**Task:** Write a **brief internal status update** for the CISO using the template format from the lesson.

**Template:**
```
INCIDENT UPDATE - [Incident ID] - [Time UTC]

Status: [Active / Containing / Recovering / Closed]
Impact: [Brief description of business impact]
Current Action: [What the team is doing right now]
Next Update: [Time]

Decision Needed: [Specific approval required]
```

**Output Format:** Plain text using the template.
hints: Be concise. Use bullet points or short sentences.
expectedOutput:
INCIDENT UPDATE - IR-2026-042 - 14:30 UTC

Status: Active Containment
Impact: Accounting file server (FS01) encrypted. 45 users unable to access financial data.
Current Action: Server VLAN isolated. Recovery team preparing to restore from backup (ETA 4 hours).
Next Update: 15:00 UTC

Decision Needed: Approve emergency firewall change to block outbound SMB (port 445) traffic to prevent potential lateral spread to VPN users.
solutionCode:
INCIDENT UPDATE - IR-2026-042 - 14:30 UTC

Status: Active Containment
Impact: Accounting file server (FS01) encrypted. 45 users unable to access financial data. No evidence of data exfiltration at this time.
Current Action: Affected VLAN isolated. Recovery team preparing restore from immutable backup dated 2026-04-19. EDR scanning additional hosts in VLAN.
Next Update: 15:00 UTC

Decision Needed: Approve emergency change to implement outbound SMB (port 445) block at perimeter firewall as precautionary containment measure.
